extracted.name: The Polar Express Creamy Hot Chocolate
extracted.description: This Polar Express hot chocolate is made with milk chocolate chips, cream, and condensed milk simmered in a slow cooker for a wintertime beverage.
instruction_lines: Combine milk, chocolate chips, condensed milk, heavy cream, and vanilla in a slow cooker.
Cook on Low, stirring occasionally, until heated through, about 2 hours. Let cool until safe to drink, about 5 minutes.
